name: enable_spawn_group

stack.evidence: func_001D7850 consumes one group ID and passes it to func_0014EE78, which sets bit group_id - 1 in the spawn-group enable mask D_00553BEC

notes: This is the single-group counterpart of command 363 enable_all_spawn_groups; its neighboring inverse func_001D7808 calls func_0014EE50 to clear the same bit. All nine JP calls occur in ew23.ard and pass group IDs used by adjacent spawn-group object-count queries.
